episodeList.description: Stealing a gold shipment from an undefended pleasure cruiser en route to Earth seems too good an opportunity to miss.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: 4-11 Orbit
episodeList.description: A renegade Federation scientist makes an interesting offer to Avon.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: 4-12 Warlord
episodeList.description: Avon calls a meeting on Xenon between the five most powerful factions resisting the Federation.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: 4-13 Blake
episodeList.description: The crew think they are going to be able to run away from the Federation, but Avon has other ideas, and sets off to find Blake.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-1 The Way Back
episodeList.description: Roj Blake discovers shocking secrets about his past, pitting him against the tyrannical Federation.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-2 Space Fall
episodeList.description: Aboard a prison colony transport, Blake meets future comrades and encounters a mysterious space vessel that could liberate Earth from the grip of the Federation.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-3 Cygnus Alpha
episodeList.description: Blake and his crew uncover more of the Liberator's secrets, then follow the prison ship to Cygnus Alpha to mount a bold rescue mission.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-4 Time Squad
episodeList.description: Blake plans his first strike against the Federation, recruiting an extra crew member in the process.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-5 The Web
episodeList.description: Inhabitants of an uncharted world threaten the lives of the Liberator crew.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-6 Seek-Locate-Destroy
episodeList.description: Ruthless Supreme Commander Servalan enlists Space Commander Travis to track down and eliminate Blake and his band of freedom fighters.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-7 Mission to Destiny
episodeList.description: Blake and his crew stumble upon a murder mystery aboard a drifting freighter.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-8 Duel
episodeList.description: Travis hunts down the Liberator and Blake must face his arch-enemy in hand-to-hand combat.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-9 Project Avalon
episodeList.description: Travis holds a resistance leader captive, prompting Blake to launch a rescue mission.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-10 Breakdown
episodeList.description: The behavioural limiter implanted in Gan's brain begins to malfunction, threatening the lives of everyone aboard the Liberator.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-11 Bounty
episodeList.description: While Blake attemps to prevent a civil war, a bounty hunter takes control of the Liberator to deliver its crew to the Federation.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-12 Deliverance
episodeList.description: Stranded on an alien planet, Avon, Vila and Gan discover an ancient space capsule, while Blake discovers that the Federation are hunting for a device called Orac.

episodeList.title: BLAKE'S-7: A-13 Orac
episodeList.description: The Liberator crew converge on the planet Aristo to find the mysterious Orac, but Servalon and Travis are also on its trail.

episodeList.title: RED DWARF: 5-3 Terrorform
episodeList.description: Rimmer is taken prisoner in his own mind.

episodeList.title: RED DWARF: 5-4 Quarantine
episodeList.description: Rimmer forces the crew to spend 12 weeks in quarantine.

episodeList.title: RED DWARF: 5-5 Demons and Angels
episodeList.description: The Red Dwarf crew create good and evil doppelgängers of themselves.

episodeList.title: RED DWARF: 5-6 Back to Reality
episodeList.description: The crew of Red Dwarf discover an abandoned space ship on an ocean bed.

episodeList.title: RED DWARF: 6-5 Rimmerworld
episodeList.description: After escaping a disintegrating ship, Rimmer's pod is sucked into a wormhole in time.

episodeList.title: RED DWARF: 6-6 Out of Time
episodeList.description: The crew encounter several unreality bubbles.
